title: REVA pairing QR payload
description: The JSON inside the pairing QR code. The QR text is the prefix REVA-PAIR1: followed by the unpadded base64url encoding of this object (UTF-8, compact, keys sorted). The phone must check the gateway's TLS public key (SHA-256 of its SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER) against gw before sending anything, and must refuse the code after exp.

host.description: LAN address of the pairing gateway on the PC.

code.description: One-time pairing code. Valid for one phone and a short time.

gw.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the gateway TLS public key, SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER.

exp.description: Unix time (seconds) after which the code is refused.
